chapter_seo_title: Daofather Descends & Realm War Scale Revealed | Desolate Era Chapter 546
chapter_meta_description: The Realm War escalates! Ji Ning meets the prickly Evergreen Sword Immortal. The true, terrifying scale of the conflict is revealed with over 300,000 Celestial Immortals mobilizing. A Daofather has arrived.
og_title: The Gods of War Begin to March in Desolate Era
og_description: The calm before the storm shatters. Learn the shocking scale of the Realm War and meet the Daofather who will lead the charge.
twitter_title: The Army of 300,000 Immortals Has Arrived
twitter_description: The Realm War's true, terrifying scale is revealed. Ji Ning meets a prickly sword immortal. The war is about to begin.

lore_anchors.definition: A cold and arrogant True Immortal and Sword Immortal who was originally asked by the Xia Emperor to take Ji Ning as a disciple. He holds no warm feelings toward Ji Ning.
A founding elder of the Seamless Gate who survived the ancient Dawn War. He has now been dispatched to personally oversee the Realm War against the Grand Xia.
The ruler of the Seamless Gate and the sole disciple of the slumbering existence that created the organization. He holds absolute authority over his subordinates.
A large-scale, inter-realmvers war fought by the forces of Daofathers, involving hundreds of Celestial Immortals, millions of Loose Immortals, and numerous True Gods and True Immortals.
A True Immortal who has perfected the five elemental Daos and transformed their Golden Core, reaching a higher level of power and foundation compared to a standard True Immortal.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why was the Evergreen Sword Immortal so rude to Ji Ning?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Evergreen is a proud and prickly character who never truly wanted to be a teacher. His rudeness is a rejection of social obligation, a way to draw a clear line and avoid any future expectations of friendship or favor.

A Realm War is a conflict fought across an entire realmverse, usually between two Daofather-led factions. It involves armies of hundreds of thousands of Celestial Immortals and millions of Loose Immortals, with True Gods and True Immortals serving as high-tier commanders.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why can't the Daofathers just fight each other directly?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Daofathers are a strategic deterrent. If one were to act directly, the opposing side's Daofathers would also act, leading to an immediate, uncontrolled escalation that would trigger the final, devastating war both sides wish to avoid.
